scope: Per-session old/new Q-Rust comparisons with complete-cell and all-warmup eligibility. New SDK comparisons retain the exact primary schedule and recipes. Repeated trials/seeds are not additional circuits; numerical evidence is not a theorem. Structural counts are not device execution fidelity.

external.validation_contract: Unchanged independent NumPy analytic gate oracle, AFTER ALL timing sessions. Full numerical isometry through six physical qubits; three basis, uniform and four seeded Haar inputs otherwise through sixteen qubits. Shared global phase, full physical amplitudes, residual tolerance 1e-7. Sampled evidence is not a proof; CX and depth are not execution fidelity.

matched.validation_contract: Independent map-aware Clifford Choi-isometry comparison with exact signed-Pauli arithmetic after numerically bounded 1q Clifford recognition. All logical inputs including zero-initialized spare wires; non-Clifford output fails closed. Basis/edge checks separate. Verification only after both sessions.
